findings.evidence: Lines 45 and 74 both have `(hermiteHilbertBasis 𝕜).repr ...` as their left-hand side. Mathlib’s directly analogous declarations are `fourierBasis_repr` and `mFourierBasis_repr` in `Mathlib/Analysis/Fourier/AddCircle.lean:422` and `AddCircleMulti.lean:275`; the generic source lemmas are `HilbertBasis.repr_apply_apply` and `HilbertBasis.repr_self`.
findings.fix: Rename them along the lines of `hermiteHilbertBasis_repr_apply` and `hermiteHilbertBasis_repr_hermiteFunctionLp` (or `hermiteHilbertBasis_repr_self`) and update references.
findings.issue: `repr_hermiteFunctionLp_apply` and `repr_hermiteFunctionLp` (line 73) obscure that both conclusions describe `hermiteHilbertBasis.repr`; the naming guide requires conclusion-first names and removal of a namespaced definition’s namespace only when unambiguous.

summary: The two coordinate lemmas are named after `hermiteFunctionLp` even though their principal operation is `hermiteHilbertBasis.repr`, making them inconsistent with adjacent Mathlib basis-coordinate APIs.
